title: Social Commerce Analytics & Influencer Intelligence
thesis: Snowflake processes social commerce data from Amazon Comprehend pipeline, replaces it with native AI_SENTIMENT + AI_EXTRACT, builds influencer ROI scores, and uses Cortex Complete for personalized product recommendations

talking_points: ₱2.1 billion social commerce revenue this quarter — 2,800 active influencer partnerships.
TikTok Shop now 38% of social commerce — growing 85% QoQ.
Brand sentiment: +0.72 overall but K-beauty competitor campaign dropped us to +0.54 this week.
show: Show channel mix pie chart with TikTok growth
tabs.call_out: TikTok Shop at 38% — competitor campaign impacting sentiment

transition.line: Let's drill into what's working and what needs attention.

talking_points: Top 10% of influencers drive 62% of attributed revenue — nano-influencers have highest ROAS.
Average ROAS: 4.2x for nano, 3.1x for micro, 2.4x for macro, 1.8x for mega.
AI_EXTRACT identifies: product mentions in 78% of top-performing posts correlate with purchases.
tabs.call_out: Nano-influencers deliver 4.2x ROAS — invest more, not bigger

transition.line: The data is clear on where to invest. Let's see what's trending.

talking_points: AI_SENTIMENT + AI_EXTRACT processing 1.2M posts — trending now: Korean skincare bundles.
Live selling format: 3.2x higher conversion than static posts.
Cortex Complete generates personalized recommendations for 1.5M audience segments.
tabs.call_out: Live selling converts 3.2x higher — double down on live format

transition.line: Let the Head of Digital Commerce ask the system directly.

talking_points: Samantha asks: 'Which influencer campaign had the highest ROI this month?'
Cortex Analyst: 'Beauty Haul' with @KathNielBeauty — ₱8.4M revenue on ₱1.2M spend (7x ROAS).
Follow-up: 'What are people saying about our sunscreen launch?' — searches 1.2M posts.
tabs.call_out: Two AI modes: SQL analytics + social content search

talking_points: Social feeds → AI_SENTIMENT + AI_EXTRACT → Dynamic Tables → Cortex Complete recommendations.
Replaces Amazon Comprehend + Personalize with native Snowflake AI functions.
Filipinos: #1 social media users globally (4.1 hours/day). Social commerce is a ₱280B market.
tabs.call_out: Native AI functions — sentiment, extraction, recommendations — all SQL

transition.line: That's Snowflake and AWS — better together for Philippine social commerce.
